title: Easy to monitor my routine!
body: I started using Eden a month ago and I would recommend this to anyone. It is simple to understand and great for beginners who wants to keep up with healthy routines for a glow up! I’m glad they also have a lifetime subscription. It’s worth to save this app in my phone. When I’m halfway or managed to reach all my routines, Eden is also designed to give a words of encouragement and that is very thoughtful. Thank you developer.
author: Ednusr
